groups.name: t2-adv
groups.pilot: stress 2026-11-25 (scripts/heavy.sh, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=4, 4070 host, CPU only): python -m cfcap.runner t2_adv --task-spec cfcap.t2.adv:TASK --shard 0 --n-shards 1 --out /tmp/advp --restarts 3 --pop 256 --iters 3: 8.6 s per CEM iteration on a pair (256 members x 10 legs on T1 CPU + T2 numba), so a 25-iteration restart = ~215 s at 4 threads (a single is cheaper); 360 restarts = ~86 thread-h. Best T1-oracle confident-wrong margin after 3 iterations: 0.11-0.15.
groups.purpose: Adversarial CEM search over latents, faults, payload and T2 effect factors for confident-wrong certificates on single and pair modules (T2 truth, T1-oracle certifier).
